crossRefs.note: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.
He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.
Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

translations.web: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out, and it was restored to full use, just like the other.
translations.kjv: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
translations.asv: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, as the other.
